svg.data-power-max-scope: 45 C, optics fully populated, 100% traffic load (HIG, both builds)
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO with optional holdover; ITU-T Synchronous Ethernet (SyncE); IEEE 1588v2 default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 (additional licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC; Time Sensitive Networking (TSN); Class C timing accuracy. NOS integration is required to activate the specific feature, which the datasheet states with an asterisk against the whole block
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations, supporting GPS/QZSS L1 C/A, GLONASS L10F, BeiDou B1, SBAS L1 C/A (WAAS, EGNOS, MSAS, GAGAN) and Galileo E1B/C at a minimum RF sensitivity of -166 dBm; passive and active antennas are auto-detected and an active antenna is fed up to 5 V DC / 150 mA
svg.data-breakout: the four SFP28 ports break out from 100G port 0; enabling them disables port 0
svg.data-compliance-programme: IEEE 802.1CM fronthaul; ITU-T G.8273.2 T-BC Class C
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR/ER and 10G SFP+ SR/LR/ER, up to 40 km
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS in on SMA; 1PPS in/out on SMB; 10MHz in/out on SMB; ToD in/out on RJ45. Cable types the datasheet specifies: 50 ohm SMA coax with a 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS, 50 ohm SMB coax with a 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz, shielded RJ45 for ToD
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 at 115200 8N1 plus a micro-USB serial console (CP210x)
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 55024; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A

g.data-description: the datasheet's 1 x 100/1000M RJ45 management port. Its two lamps are drawn because Figure 8 draws them green in the jack's lower corners; HIG section 10 tables the six front-panel lamps and the two FRU lamps and gives this jack no table, unlike the S9510-28DC guide, so they keep the component default rather than that platform's vocabulary. common/rj45-port@4 drew this jack keyway-up (lamps at the top) by default, the opposite of Figure 8; common/rj45-eth@1 is keyway-down by default already, matching the photo directly, so no rotate is added
g.title: mgmt

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYNC row - Off (system timing synchronization is disabled), Solid Green (system timing, 1588 and SyncE, synchronized to an external timing/clock reference: GNSS, 1PPS, PTP), Blinking Green (system is synchronized in SyncE mode), Solid Amber (timing/clock synchronization is in free-run or holdover mode). This table lists no blinking amber for this lamp
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYS row - OFF (no power), Solid Green (system boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but system boot has failed). Three rows, no blink states
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, FAN row - OFF (no FAN modules present or FAN modules are not initialized), Solid Green (all FAN modules are working normal), Blinking Amber (one or more FAN modules need service)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PS0 row - OFF (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 is working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU0 fail, PSU0 need service)
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PS1 row - OFF (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 is working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU1 fail, PSU1 need service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, ID row - OFF (no power), Blinking Blue (enabled beacon feature). The only blue lamp on the panel and the only one with two rows
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: ports 0-3 in their own run, the datasheet's '4 x 1/10/25G SFP28 ports (In-band port share with 100GE Port 0)' - a 2x2 quad in one shell at the left of the port block, under a yellow legend band. They are the breakout of QSFP28 port 0 and enabling them disables it
g.title: sfp-0
